info.title: Kaneo API
info.description: Kaneo Project Management API - Manage projects, tasks, labels, and more

ApiKeyRateLimited.description: The API key exceeded its rate limit or usage quota. Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After before retrying. The X-RateLimit headers are sent only when the rate limit was hit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Omitted when an exhausted usage quota never refills.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the API key may make per window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time in seconds when the current window resets.

code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code. Derived from the status unless a more specific code applies, such as VALIDATION_ERROR or MISSING_PERMISSION.

path.description: Dotted path to the invalid input, prefixed with the request part (body, query, params, header).

missingPermissions.description: Permissions the caller lacks for this route, as resource:action, for MISSING_PERMISSION and API_KEY_SCOPE.

descriptionDeferred.description: True when the list omits a large description; load the task detail or description pages to read it. Do not replace stored text with this null summary.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

subtaskCounts.description: Direct subtasks in the workspace; completed means a final column in the child project. Public boards count only children in public projects.

metadata.description: Provider-specific payload, already parsed from the stored JSON string.

relatedRevision.description: Public board labels and external links revision for this task page. Restart pagination if it changes during related-page continuations.

revision.description: Public board content, membership and ordering revision, including related records and visible subtask progress. Restart pagination if it changes between task or related pages.

BoardPagination.description: Always paginated: 50 tasks by default, at most 100 per page. Continue through totalPages to retrieve all tasks. For each task page, follow relatedPage through relatedTotalPages to retrieve all labels, external links and columns (100 related rows per kind per request, plus up to 100 columns needed to represent the tasks).

descriptionDeferred.description: True when a project description above 64 KiB is omitted; use project detail or public project description pages for full text.

redirect.description: Where to send the browser next: back to the client with a code on approval, or with an error on denial.

idToken.description: The stored id_token for the user's `custom` OAuth account, or null when they have no such account.

slug.description: Short prefix used in task identifiers, e.g. KAN-12.

isPublic.description: When true the project's board is readable without signing in, via /api/public-project/{id}.

archivedAt.description: Non-null once archived; archived projects are hidden by default.

lastTaskNumber.description: Highest task number issued in this project; the next task gets this plus one.

dueDate.description: The soonest due date among the project's open tasks.

total.description: All open tasks assigned to the caller, including any beyond the first 100 returned.

status.description: The slug of the column the task sits in.

statusName.description: The column's display name. Null for tasks outside a column, such as planned ones.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

key.description: Object key to send back to the finalize route.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned URL to PUT the image bytes to.

headers.description: Headers that must accompany the upload request, including Content-Type.

url.description: Where the stored image can be read back from.

descriptionDeferred.description: True when the list omits a large description; load the task detail or description pages to read it. Do not replace stored text with this null summary.

status.description: The slug of the column the task sits in.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the task's project.
The workspace currently owning the task's project. Included in the detail view; omitted from the compact board view.

columnId.description: The referenced workflow column; null for virtual statuses and legacy tasks without a column reference.

labels.description: Label names and colors, without their ids.

tasks.description: Per-task outcome, each carrying a success flag.

slug.description: Stable identifier derived from the name; tasks store this as their status.

position.description: Board order, ascending. Columns are always returned sorted by it.

isFinal.description: Marks the column as a done state, which stops overdue reminders for tasks in it.

type.description: One of: comment, task, create, status_changed, priority_changed, assignee_changed, unassigned, due_date_changed, title_changed, description_changed.

eventData.description: Type-specific payload. For status_changed, oldStatus/newStatus are slugs and oldStatusName/newStatusName carry current configured column names when available.

excerpt.description: Plain-text preview of the stored content, at most 240 characters: the comment body, or the description older system events carry instead of eventData.

type.description: One of: comment, task, create, status_changed, priority_changed, assignee_changed, unassigned, due_date_changed, title_changed, description_changed.

eventData.description: Type-specific payload, e.g. { oldStatus, newStatus } for status_changed. Null for plain comments.

externalUserName.description: Set when the activity was imported from another tool.

externalSource.description: The tool it was imported from, e.g. planka, trello, jira.

userId.description: Null once the user who logged the time has been removed.

endTime.description: Null while the timer is still running.

duration.description: Elapsed seconds, filled in once the entry has an endTime.

content.description: Free-text body. Null for generated notifications, whose text the client renders from type and eventData.

type.description: One of: info, task_created, workspace_created, task_status_changed, task_assignee_changed, time_entry_created, due_date_reminder, task_overdue, task_mention, task_comment.

eventData.description: Type-specific payload, e.g. { taskTitle, oldStatus, newStatus, projectId, workspaceId }.

resourceId.description: The id of the task or workspace the notification points at.

dueDateReminderLeadTimeMinutes.description: How long before a due date the reminder fires, in minutes.

workspaces.description: Per-workspace overrides. A workspace with no rule follows the global settings.

isActive.description: Turn all notifications for this workspace on or off.

projectMode.description: `all` notifies for every project in the workspace; `selected` restricts it to selectedProjectIds.

totalCount.description: Total matches found before the `limit` slice, so a caller can tell that more exist.

content.description: Matched body text, for comment and activity results. Activities get a rendered summary such as `changed status from Todo to In Progress`.

relevanceScore.description: Higher is a better match. Results are sorted by score, then by createdAt descending.

outgoing.description: Kaneo workspace label IDs controlling task sync. Missing labels pause sync.

incoming.description: Exact repository label names controlling which issues can be imported.
